_comment: Training programs. Every exercise has a number (sets x reps, seconds or rounds) so progress is measurable; tests enforce that. RPE = rate of perceived exertion, 1-10: RPE 3 easy, 6 can chat, 8 can say a few words, 9 near max. General fitness guidance, not medical advice.
safety: Check with a doctor before starting if you have an injury, a heart or joint condition, or you're pregnant. Warm up first. Choose weights where the last 2 reps are hard but your form stays clean. Stop if you feel sharp pain, dizziness or chest pain.

R1.title: Active recovery: mobility flow
R1.warmup: Walk in place for 2 minutes to get warm.

exercises.cue: Move with your breath; round, then arch the spine.
Lunge, rotate the chest toward the front knee and reach up.
Sit tall, move slowly between sides.
Reach under and rotate through the upper back.
Breathe into the back of your ribs.

R1.cooldown: Breathe slowly for 1 minute: 4 s in, 6 s out.
R1.metric: Rate how stiff you feel before and after, 1 to 10.

R2.title: Active recovery: stretch + easy walk
R2.warmup: Easy walk for 10 minutes at RPE 3 (you could sing).

exercises.cue: Hinge from the hips, back flat.
Knees together, tuck the pelvis.
Ankle on opposite knee, lean forward.
Back heel stays down.
Elbows at shoulder height.

R2.cooldown: Finish with 5 slow breaths lying on your back.
R2.metric: Note any area that felt tight so you can warm it up longer next session.

cardio_core.name: Cardio Intervals + Core
cardio_core.tagline: Burn calories with timed intervals, then build a strong core
cardio_core.equipment_note: A timer. A jump rope, bike or running route is optional (high knees work too).
cardio_core.progression: Every 2 weeks add 1 interval round (up to 12) or cut the easy time by 10 s. For core holds, add 5 seconds each week.

A.title: Interval session 1
A.warmup: 5 min easy jog or march in place, then 10 leg swings per side and 10 arm circles each way.

exercises.cue: Run, bike, jump rope or high knees. RPE 8 means you can say a few words, not a sentence.
Ribs down, squeeze your glutes.
Lower back stays pressed into the floor.

A.cooldown: 5 min walk, then hamstring and calf stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Log the rounds you finished and how far or how many jumps you did in the last hard interval.

B.title: Lower body + core
B.warmup: 5 min brisk walk, then 10 bodyweight squats and 10 glute bridges.

exercises.cue: Sit back, knees track over toes, heels down.
Step back, front shin stays vertical.

exercises.n: Glute bridge with 2 s pause at top
exercises.cue: Drive through heels, ribs down.
Full range, 2 s up and 2 s down.
Body in one line, hips high.

B.cooldown: Hip flexor stretch and quad stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Count total squats completed with good form.

C.title: Pyramid intervals
C.warmup: 5 min easy jog or march, then 20 s of high knees.

exercises.cue: Hard at RPE 8 for 30, 45, 60, 45, then 30 s, each followed by an equal-length easy interval. Pace so the 60 s effort is as strong as the 30 s one.
Slow; rotate the ribcage, not just the elbows.
Lower back flat; bend the knees if it arches.
Hold 2 s at full reach, hips level.

C.cooldown: 5 min easy walk, then a child's pose for 45 s.
C.metric: Note the distance or jumps in your first and last 60 s effort.

D.title: Pilates-style core + mobility
D.warmup: 2 min cat-cow and 10 slow bodyweight squats.

exercises.n: The Hundred (small arm pumps, legs at tabletop)
exercises.cue: Inhale for 5 pumps, exhale for 5.
Keep the head and shoulders lifted.
Peel up one vertebra at a time.

exercises.n: Swimming (face down, alternate arm and leg lifts)
exercises.cue: Long neck, reach long.
Top toe points slightly down, hips stacked.
Hips stay level as the foot lifts.

D.metric: Rate your control from 1 to 10 after each exercise and aim to beat it next week.

E.title: Steady-state cardio + legs
E.warmup: 5 min easy jog or bike, then 10 bodyweight squats.

exercises.n: Steady run, bike or brisk incline walk
exercises.cue: RPE 6 means you can hold a conversation in short sentences.

exercises.n: Step-up (onto a sturdy chair or step)
exercises.cue: Press through the whole foot, no pushing off the back leg.
Keep hips from swaying.

E.cooldown: 5 min walk and a calf stretch, 30 s per side.
E.metric: Log the distance covered in the 25 minutes.

bodyweight.name: Bodyweight Strength
bodyweight.tagline: Build strength anywhere with no equipment
bodyweight.equipment_note: Floor space. A sturdy table (for rows), a couch and a chair help.
bodyweight.progression: When you hit the top of the rep range on every set, move to a harder variation (push-ups: knees, then floor, then feet raised). Otherwise add 1 to 2 reps per week.

A.title: Push
A.warmup: 2 min arm circles and shoulder rolls, then 10 incline push-ups.

exercises.n: Push-up (knees or hands on a counter if you can't do 8 clean reps)
exercises.cue: Straight line from head to heels; chest to about a fist from the floor.
Hips high, head moves toward the floor between the hands.
Elbows point back, shoulders stay down.
Squeeze glutes and quads.

A.cooldown: Doorway chest stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Log your total push-up reps across the 4 sets.

B.title: Legs
B.warmup: 3 min march in place, then 10 glute bridges and 10 bodyweight squats.

exercises.n: Tempo squat (3 s down, 1 s up)
exercises.cue: Chest tall, depth to parallel or lower.

exercises.n: Bulgarian split squat (rear foot on a couch)
exercises.cue: Front foot far enough forward that the shin stays vertical.
Pause 1 s at the top.
Thighs parallel to the floor.
Pause at the top for 1 s.

B.cooldown: Quad and hamstring stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Log the reps on your weaker leg in the split squats.

C.title: Pull + core
C.warmup: 2 min arm circles, then 10 cat-cow and 10 scapular push-ups.

exercises.n: Inverted row (under a sturdy table, feet on the floor)
exercises.cue: Pull the chest to the table edge, body stays straight.
Thumbs up, sweep the arms to the hips.
Lift chest and thighs, keep the neck long.
Lower back pressed down.
Lower slowly; don't let the back arch.

C.cooldown: Child's pose, 45 s, then a lat stretch against a wall, 30 s per side.
C.metric: Log your inverted row reps; when you reach 12 on all sets, lower your body angle.

D.title: Full-body circuit
D.warmup: 3 min jumping jacks or march, then 10 squats and 5 push-ups.

exercises.cue: 10 squats, 8 push-ups, 10 reverse lunges per leg, 20 mountain climbers, 30 s plank. Move steadily and keep every rep clean.

D.cooldown: Walk for 3 minutes, then stretch your quads, hamstrings and chest, 30 s each.
D.metric: Time each round and try to finish the last round as fast as the first.

E.title: Conditioning ladder
E.warmup: 3 min easy jog or march, then 10 squats.

exercises.rest: whatever is left of each minute
exercises.cue: Every minute: minute 1 = 15 squat jumps (or 20 squats), minute 2 = 10 push-ups, minute 3 = 20 mountain climbers. If you can't finish inside the minute, cut the reps by 20%.
Stay square to the floor.

E.cooldown: Walk for 3 minutes and stretch your calves and hips.
E.metric: Log how many rounds you finished with seconds to spare.

boxing.name: Boxing Conditioning
boxing.tagline: Punch, move and sweat in timed rounds
boxing.equipment_note: A timer. A jump rope, hand wraps and a heavy bag are optional.
boxing.progression: Add 1 round every 2 weeks (up to 8), or cut the rest between rounds from 60 s to 45 s.

A.title: Shadow boxing basics
A.warmup: 3 min jump rope or jog, then arm circles and 10 torso rotations.

exercises.n: Shadow boxing: jab and cross only (1-2)
exercises.cue: Rotate the back foot, return your hands to your chin.
Keep knees soft and chin down.
Punch as you stand up.
Tight core.

A.cooldown: 5 min walk, then shoulder and chest stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Count the number of rounds where you kept your hands up the whole time.

B.title: Footwork + legs
B.warmup: 3 min easy rope or jog, then 10 bodyweight squats.

exercises.n: Jump rope (or imaginary rope, boxer shuffle)
exercises.cue: Stay on the balls of your feet; small hops.

exercises.n: Lunge with punches (jab-cross as you step)
exercises.cue: Land the punch as the foot lands.
Land softly, knees over toes.
Full range.

B.cooldown: Calf, quad and hip flexor stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Log the total rope minutes without a stop.

C.title: Combination rounds
C.warmup: 3 min jump rope, then 2 easy rounds of shadow boxing at RPE 4.

exercises.cue: Combo 1-2-3-2 (jab, cross, hook, cross) with a slip after each combo, on the bag or in the air. Punch with the hips and exhale on every punch.
Straight body line.
Bend the knees and drive up through the legs.

C.cooldown: 5 min walk, shoulder rolls and a triceps stretch, 30 s per side.
C.metric: Log how many rounds you held RPE 7 without slowing down.

D.title: Core + conditioning
D.warmup: 3 min jog or rope, then 10 torso rotations.

exercises.cue: Rotate the ribs; feet down if needed.
Slow and controlled.
Step back instead of jumping if you need to.
Stay light on your feet.

D.metric: Log how many burpees you did in the first and last set.

E.title: Sparring-style rounds
E.warmup: 4 min jump rope, then 2 easy shadow boxing rounds.

exercises.cue: Circle, jab, slip and counter, as if against an opponent. Keep moving even when you're not punching.
Quick, small hops.

E.cooldown: 5 min walk and a full-body stretch, 30 s each for shoulders, hips and calves.
E.metric: Log your heart-rate recovery: how long it takes to feel normal after round 8.

split_lifting.name: Push / Pull / Legs Lifting
split_lifting.tagline: Classic weight training split for muscle and definition
split_lifting.equipment_note: Dumbbells and a bench at home, or a gym. Leave 1-2 reps in reserve on every set.
split_lifting.progression: Double progression: when you reach the top of the rep range on every set, add 2.5-5 lb (1-2 kg) next session and start at the bottom of the range again. Write your weights down.

A.title: Push
A.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 2 light sets (10 reps at 50%) of the first lift.

exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinched, lower for 2 s.
Ribs down, don't arch the back.
Bench at 30 degrees.
Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.
Keep elbows pointing forward.

A.cooldown: Chest and shoulder stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Write down the weight and reps for every set.

B.title: Pull
B.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 2 light sets of rows.

exercises.cue: Pull the elbow toward your hip, no twisting.
Pull the elbows down, chest up.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together for 1 s.
Light weight, controlled.
Elbows pinned to your sides.

B.cooldown: Lat stretch and biceps stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Write down the weight and reps for every set.

C.title: Legs
C.warmup: 5 min bike or brisk walk, then 10 bodyweight squats and 10 hip hinges.

exercises.cue: Brace your core, knees track over toes.
Hips back, flat back, feel the hamstrings.
Long steps, torso upright.
Squeeze at the top for 1 s.
Full stretch at the bottom.

C.cooldown: Quad, hamstring and calf stretch, 30 s per side.
C.metric: Write down the weight and reps for every set.

D.title: Upper body (higher reps)
D.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 2 light sets of the first lift.

exercises.cue: Full range, body straight.
Smooth and controlled.
Full stretch at the top.
Elbows tucked.
No swinging.

D.cooldown: Shoulder and chest stretch, 30 s per side.
D.metric: Count the total reps on your push-ups and beat it next week.

E.title: Lower body + core
E.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 10 glute bridges and 10 squats.

exercises.cue: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom.
Chin tucked, pause 1 s at the top.
Drive through the front heel.
Keep the lower back down.
Strong and straight.

E.cooldown: Glute and hip flexor stretch, 30 s per side.
E.metric: Write down the hip thrust weight and add 5 lb when you hit 10 reps on all sets.

athletic_circuit.name: Athletic Circuits
athletic_circuit.tagline: Strength, sprints and circuits like an athlete
athletic_circuit.equipment_note: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, and room to run or a bike.
athletic_circuit.progression: Add 1 round every 2 weeks (up to 5), or cut the rest by 15 s. On strength days, add 2.5-5 lb once you hit the top of the rep range.

A.title: Full-body strength 1
A.warmup: 5 min jog or bike, then 10 bodyweight squats and 10 push-ups.

exercises.cue: Chest tall, heels down.
Control the lowering for 2 s.
Flat back.
Hips back, soft knees.
Tall posture, shoulders down.

A.cooldown: 5 min walk, then a hamstring and chest stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Write down the weight for each lift.

B.title: Sprint intervals
B.warmup: 8 min easy jog, 3 × 20 m strides (building to 80% speed), 10 leg swings per side.

exercises.cue: Run, bike or rower. Start each one fast and hold your form.
Squeeze at the top.

B.cooldown: 5 min easy jog or walk, then calf and quad stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Log the distance of your first and last interval; they should be within 10%.

C.title: Conditioning circuit
C.warmup: 4 min jog or jump rope, then 10 squats and 10 arm circles.

exercises.cue: 45 s work / 15 s rest at each station: kettlebell or dumbbell swing, push-up, reverse lunge, bent-over row, mountain climber, plank. Count your reps at each station.

C.cooldown: 5 min walk and a full-body stretch, 30 s each for quads, hamstrings and chest.
C.metric: Log your total reps on the push-up station for each round.

D.title: Full-body strength 2
D.warmup: 5 min cardio, then 10 hip hinges and 10 band or arm pulls.

exercises.cue: Back knee drops straight down.
Squeeze glutes, don't lean back.

exercises.n: Pull-up, assisted pull-up or inverted row
exercises.cue: Chest to the bar or table.
Pause 1 s at the top.
Hips high.

D.cooldown: 5 min walk, then hip flexor and lat stretch, 30 s per side.
D.metric: Write down the weight for each lift.

E.title: Speed + power
E.warmup: 5 min jog, 10 leg swings per side, 3 × 20 m strides.

exercises.n: Shuttle run (20 m out and back)
exercises.cue: Plant, push off, accelerate.
Small hops, quick feet.
Land softly, reset between reps.

E.cooldown: 5 min walk, then calf and quad stretch, 30 s per side.
E.metric: Time your first and last shuttle run; they should be within 1 second.

strength_first.name: Strength First
strength_first.tagline: Heavy, simple lifts and steady progress
strength_first.equipment_note: A barbell, rack and bench, or heavy dumbbells (use 5 × 8 instead of 5 × 5 if your weights are light).
strength_first.progression: Linear progression: if you finish every rep, add 5 lb (2.5 kg) to squat and deadlift and 2.5 lb (1 kg) to presses next session. Miss reps twice at one weight? Drop 10% and build again.

A.title: Squat + bench + row
A.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then ramp-up sets: 2 × 5 at 50% and 1 × 3 at 75% of today's working weight.

exercises.cue: Brace your core, hips and chest rise together.
Shoulder blades back, feet planted.
Flat back, pull to the lower ribs.

A.cooldown: 5 min walk, then hip and chest stretch, 30 s per side.
A.metric: Write down the weight for each lift and whether you finished all 25 reps.

B.title: Squat + press + deadlift
B.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then ramp-up sets of the first lift.

exercises.cue: Same depth every rep.
Squeeze glutes, bar over mid-foot.
Flat back, push the floor away.

B.cooldown: 5 min walk, then hamstring and hip stretch, 30 s per side.
B.metric: Write down the weight for each lift.

C.title: Light squat + bench + row
C.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then ramp-up sets.

exercises.n: Back squat at 80% of Monday's weight
exercises.cue: Move fast and crisp.
Add 2.5 lb when you finish all reps.
Controlled.

C.cooldown: 5 min walk, then a quad and chest stretch, 30 s per side.
C.metric: Write down the weights and rate each set's difficulty from 1 to 10.

D.title: Deadlift + press + pull-ups
D.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then ramp-up sets.

exercises.cue: Reset between reps.
Don't lean back.
Full range, chin over the bar.
Tight and level.

D.cooldown: 5 min walk, then lat and hamstring stretch, 30 s per side.
D.metric: Write down the deadlift weight and your pull-up reps.

E.title: Accessories + conditioning
E.warmup: 5 min easy cardio, then 10 hip hinges and 10 push-ups.

exercises.cue: Control down, strong up.
Elbows tucked.
Heavy, tall and tight.
No swinging.

E.cooldown: 5 min walk, then a full-body stretch, 30 s each.
E.metric: Write down the farmer carry weight and add 5 lb when it feels easy.
